audit: R3 core F independent lower_sol review

bounded_outer_scan.scope: Exact only for fixed n,t,weights and c=650..760; no global optimization over other parameters is inferred.

correlations.method: quartic expansion plus exact sums of powers through degree 4

structural_audit.endpoint_bound: Distinct integer ranks give b_{i+1}>=b_1+i and b_{s-i}<=b_s-i even when endpoint blocks overlap, so each paired difference is at most L-2i. The weighted correction is 2*sum(c-i)i=2*C(c+1,3), or 4*C(c+1,3) after doubling.
structural_audit.endpoint_identity: Summing rank gaps j=1..c cancels interior coefficients and gives sum_{i=0}^{c-1}(c-i)(b_{s-i}-b_{i+1}), with 1-based ranks exactly as serialized.
structural_audit.optimization_scope: The per-run valid c witnesses alone prove the K caps. The exhaustive c=650..760 reconstruction additionally verifies the reported bounded selection, but makes no claim for c outside that set or for other n,t,weights.
structural_audit.residual_span: For x,x+h in a span-L set, x lies between the first mark and last mark minus h, hence each FM1 completion-color fiber has span at most L-h. Summing the two Golomb fiber caps gives r_B(h)<=2Q(L-h).
structural_audit.run_monotonicity: Within a constant-K run, increasing d decreases L=n-d-1 and weakly decreases every Q(L-h). The ordered-profile minimum therefore weakly increases, while the endpoint RHS decreases. The check at lo is the weakest comparison.
structural_audit.strict_rounding: For Golomb V_h=1, exclusion is H(H+1)>L*c(c+1)-4*C(c+1,3). Thus the largest excluded integer L is floor((H(H+1)+4*C(c+1,3)-1)/(c(c+1))), explaining the -1. For a general integer P, P<=floor(RHS/2) is the exact non-strict feasibility budget, including odd RHS.
